nodes.description: uint256 public zNFTValue; aggregated NFT value, set by constructor and performUpkeep.
uint32 public cpERC20TokenPriceUSD (init 319); price input to the value formula, writable by anyone via setter.
uint32 public soldNFTCnt (init 94); used as divisor in performUpkeep, writable by anyone via setter.
uint16 public dateDay (init 3); target day read by checkUpkeep.
uint16 public dateHour (init 9); target hour read by checkUpkeep.
uint256 constant DAY_IN_SECONDS = 86400; time conversion constant.
uint256 constant YEAR_IN_SECONDS = 31536000; time conversion constant.
uint256 constant LEAP_YEAR_IN_SECONDS = 31622400; time conversion constant.
uint256 constant HOUR_IN_SECONDS = 3600; time conversion constant.
uint256 constant MINUTE_IN_SECONDS = 60; time conversion constant.
uint16 constant ORIGIN_YEAR = 1970; epoch origin for date parsing.
constructor() { zNFTValue = 67872; } initializes the aggregated value.
external setSoldNFTCnt(uint32 cnt); unauthenticated write of the divisor state variable.
external setCPERC20TokenPriceUSD(uint32 price); unauthenticated write of the price state variable.
external setDateDay(uint16 _day); unauthenticated write of the target day.
external setDateHour(uint16 _hour); unauthenticated write of the target hour.
external view checkUpkeep(bytes); parses block.timestamp and compares day/hour with state thresholds.
external performUpkeep(bytes); recomputes zNFTValue = (20000 * cpERC20TokenPriceUSD) / soldNFTCnt with no access control.
public pure isLeapYear(uint16 year); leap year predicate used by date helpers.
public pure leapYearsBefore(uint256 year); counts leap years before a year.
public pure getDaysInMonth(uint8 month, uint16 year); returns days in a month.
internal pure parseTimestamp(uint256 timestamp) returns _DateTime; full date decomposition of a timestamp.
public pure getYear(uint256 timestamp); derives the year via loop correction.
public pure getMonth(uint256 timestamp); returns parseTimestamp(timestamp).month.
public pure getDay(uint256 timestamp); returns parseTimestamp(timestamp).day.
public pure getHour(uint256 timestamp); returns (timestamp/60/60) % 24.
public pure getMinute(uint256 timestamp); returns (timestamp/60) % 60.
public pure getSecond(uint256 timestamp); returns timestamp % 60.
public pure getWeekday(uint256 timestamp); returns (timestamp/86400 + 4) % 7.
block.timestamp used in checkUpkeep to decide upkeepNeeded; miner-influenceable and manipulable.
Arithmetic in performUpkeep: (20000 * cpERC20TokenPriceUSD) / soldNFTCnt; division by an attacker-settable value (0 causes revert, extreme values skew zNFTValue).
Missing access control: setSoldNFTCnt, setCPERC20TokenPriceUSD, setDateDay, setDateHour and performUpkeep are callable by any external account to rewrite critical state.
uint32 cnt parameter of setSoldNFTCnt.
uint32 price parameter of setCPERC20TokenPriceUSD.
uint16 _day parameter of setDateDay.
uint16 _hour parameter of setDateHour.
bytes calldata checkData parameter of checkUpkeep, only echoed back as performData.
bytes calldata performData parameter of performUpkeep, unused.
uint16 year parameter of isLeapYear.
uint256 year parameter of leapYearsBefore, mutated (year -= 1).
uint8 month parameter of getDaysInMonth.
uint16 year parameter of getDaysInMonth.
uint256 timestamp parameter of parseTimestamp.
uint256 timestamp parameter of getYear.
uint256 timestamp parameter of getMonth.
uint256 timestamp parameter of getDay.
uint256 timestamp parameter of getHour.
uint256 timestamp parameter of getMinute.
uint256 timestamp parameter of getSecond.
uint256 timestamp parameter of getWeekday.
_DateTime memory dt local; parsed date result holding day/hour used by checkUpkeep.
uint256 secondsAccountedFor accumulator in parseTimestamp.
uint256 buf accumulator in parseTimestamp (leap-year seconds).
uint8 i loop index in parseTimestamp (month and day loops).
uint256 secondsInMonth accumulation inside parseTimestamp loop.
bool upkeepNeeded returned by checkUpkeep from day/hour comparison.
uint256 numLeapYears local in getYear.

edges.reason: cnt parameter is used by setSoldNFTCnt to write the soldNFTCnt state variable.
setSoldNFTCnt stores the caller-supplied count into soldNFTCnt.
price parameter flows into setCPERC20TokenPriceUSD.
setCPERC20TokenPriceUSD stores the caller-supplied price into cpERC20TokenPriceUSD.
_day parameter flows into setDateDay.
setDateDay overwrites dateDay.
_hour parameter flows into setDateHour.
setDateHour overwrites dateHour.
constructor initializes zNFTValue to a hardcoded constant.
checkData input is propagated through checkUpkeep into performData.
block.timestamp is the sole gate for upkeepNeeded, creating timestamp dependence controllable by block producers.
checkUpkeep calls parseTimestamp(block.timestamp).
checkUpkeep reads dateDay for the day comparison.
checkUpkeep reads dateHour for the hour comparison.
parseTimestamp returns the _DateTime struct into the dt local.
dt.day and dt.hour feed the upkeepNeeded decision in checkUpkeep.
checkUpkeep assigns the comparison result to upkeepNeeded.
performData parameter is accepted by performUpkeep but never used.
cpERC20TokenPriceUSD is a multiplicative input of the value formula.
soldNFTCnt is used as the divisor of the value formula; it can be set to 0 (revert/DoS) or arbitrary values by anyone.
performUpkeep executes the multiplication and division that compute zNFTValue.
The division result is written into zNFTValue without any validation of divisor magnitude.
setSoldNFTCnt is external with no owner/role check, allowing anyone to rewrite the divisor.
setCPERC20TokenPriceUSD is external with no authorization, allowing anyone to rewrite the price.
setDateDay is external with no authorization, allowing anyone to retarget the keeper trigger day.
setDateHour is external with no authorization, allowing anyone to retarget the keeper trigger hour.
performUpkeep is callable by any external account, so the value update can be triggered at will.
year parameter is evaluated by isLeapYear.
year parameter is decremented and divided in leapYearsBefore.
month parameter drives the branch selection in getDaysInMonth.
year parameter is forwarded to isLeapYear inside getDaysInMonth.
getDaysInMonth calls isLeapYear for February.
timestamp parameter is decomposed by parseTimestamp.
parseTimestamp calls getYear(timestamp).
parseTimestamp calls leapYearsBefore for its year accounting.
parseTimestamp calls getDaysInMonth in its month/day loops.
parseTimestamp calls getHour.
parseTimestamp calls getMinute.
parseTimestamp calls getSecond.
parseTimestamp calls getWeekday.
parseTimestamp maintains the secondsAccountedFor accumulator.
parseTimestamp computes buf from leap year counts.
parseTimestamp iterates with loop index i.
parseTimestamp accumulates secondsInMonth per month.
timestamp parameter is converted to a year in getYear.
getYear calls leapYearsBefore for its correction.
getYear calls isLeapYear while shrinking the year.
getYear stores the leap-year count in numLeapYears.
timestamp parameter is forwarded by getMonth.
getMonth calls parseTimestamp and returns its month field.
timestamp parameter is forwarded by getDay.
getDay calls parseTimestamp and returns its day field.
timestamp parameter is reduced to an hour by getHour.
timestamp parameter is reduced to a minute by getMinute.
timestamp parameter is reduced to a second by getSecond.
timestamp parameter is reduced to a weekday by getWeekday.

normalization_plan.reason: Parameter cnt is a transient input only meaningful as the argument of setSoldNFTCnt; fold into the function node.
Parameter price is a transient input consumed only by setCPERC20TokenPriceUSD.
Parameter _day is a transient input consumed only by setDateDay.
Parameter _hour is a transient input consumed only by setDateHour.
checkData is only echoed back as performData inside checkUpkeep; no independent semantic weight.
performData is declared but unused in performUpkeep; fold into the function node.
Parameter year is the only input of isLeapYear and carries no standalone meaning.
Parameter year is locally mutated and divided only inside leapYearsBefore.
Parameter month only selects a branch inside getDaysInMonth.
Parameter year is only forwarded to isLeapYear from getDaysInMonth.
Parameter timestamp is the decomposed input of parseTimestamp only.
Parameter timestamp is the sole input of the getYear conversion.
Parameter timestamp is passed straight to parseTimestamp inside getMonth.
Parameter timestamp is passed straight to parseTimestamp inside getDay.
Parameter timestamp is reduced arithmetically inside getHour only.
Parameter timestamp is reduced arithmetically inside getMinute only.
Parameter timestamp is reduced arithmetically inside getSecond only.
Parameter timestamp is reduced arithmetically inside getWeekday only.
_DateTime dt is the return buffer of parseTimestamp and the day/hour carrier read by checkUpkeep.
secondsAccountedFor is a scratch accumulator existing only within parseTimestamp.
buf is a temporary leap-year second counter used only within parseTimestamp.
i is a loop index local to parseTimestamp.
secondsInMonth is a per-iteration accumulator local to parseTimestamp.
upkeepNeeded is the derived boolean result returned by checkUpkeep.
numLeapYears is a scratch counter used only within getYear.
